FPKU40 NFFN 231800
NORTHERN AND SOUTHERN COOKS
WEATHER BULLETIN ISSUED FROM NWFC NADI OCT 232042 UTC.
A STRONG WIND WARNING IS NOW IN FORCE FOR NORTHERN COOK WATERS. 

SITUATION:
A SOUTH TO SOUTHEAST WIND FLOW PREVAILS OVER SOUTHERN COOKS.

A TROUGH OF LOW PRESSURE WITH CLOUD AND SHOWERS AFFECTS NORTHERN
COOKS. 

FORECAST TO MIDNIGHT TOMORROW FOR THE SOUTHERN COOKS:
CLOUDY PERIODS WITH BRIEF SHOWERS. 
MODERATE TO FRESH SOUTH TO SOUTHEAST WINDS.
MODERATE TO ROUGH SEAS. 
MODERATE SOUTHERLY SWELLS.
FURTHER OUTLOOK:    CLOUDY PERIODS WITH BRIEF SHOWERS. 

FOR RAROTONGA:
CLOUDY PERIODS WITH BRIEF SHOWERS. 
FURTHER OUTLOOK:    CLOUDY PERIODS WITH BRIEF SHOWERS. 

FOR THE NORTHERN COOKS:
OVER WATERS: SOUTHEAST WINDS 20 TO 25 KNOTS. 
OVER LAND AREAS: MODERATE TO FRESH SOUTHEAST WINDS, GUSTY AT TIMES.
ROUGH SEAS.
MODERATE SOUTHERLY SWELLS.

OCCASIONAL SHOWERS, HEAVY AT TIMES AND FEW THUNDERSTORMS.
FURTHER OUTLOOK:    OCCASIONAL SHOWERS, HEAVY AT TIMES AND FEW
THUNDERSTORMS.
